defs.d: To make (something) dirty.
To stain or tarnish (somebody) with dishonor.
Unclean; covered with or containing unpleasant substances such as dirt or grime.
defs.ex: Despite a walk in the rain, my shoes weren't too dirty.

defs.d: That makes one unclean; corrupting, infecting.
defs.ex: Don't put that in your mouth, dear. It's dirty.

defs.d: In a dirty manner.
defs.ex: to play dirty

defs.d: To inspire boredom in somebody.
To make a hole through something.
Suffering from boredom; mildly annoyed and restless through having nothing to do
Uninterested, without attention
defs.ex: The piano teacher's bored look indicated he wasn't paying much attention to his pupil's lackluster rendition of Mozart's Requiem

defs.d: A specific commercial enterprise or establishment.
defs.ex: I was left my father's business.

defs.d: A person's occupation, work, or trade.
defs.ex: He is in the motor and insurance businesses.

defs.d: Of, to, pertaining to or utilized for purposes of conducting trade, commerce, governance, advocacy or other professional purposes.
defs.ex: Please do not use this phone for personal calls; it is a business phone.

defs.d: Professional, businesslike, having concern for good business practice.
A non-academic periodical publication, generally consisting of sheets of paper folded in half and stapled at the fold.
An ammunition storehouse.
Something that is representative of all such things in a group.
Something that serves to illustrate or explain a rule.
To be illustrated or exemplified (by).
To engage the attention of; to awaken interest in; to excite emotion or passion in, in behalf of a person or thing.
defs.ex: Action films don't really interest me.

defs.d: To be concerned with or engaged in; to affect; to concern; to excite.
Of concern; affecting, important.
Arousing or holding the attention or interest of someone.
A ceremonial duty or service, particularly:
A position of responsibility.
defs.ex: When the office of Secretary of State is vacant, its duties fall upon an official within the department.

defs.d: To provide (someone) with an office.
To have an office.
Ill, unwell.
defs.ex: He's never badly.

defs.d: In a bad manner.
Very much; to a great degree.
defs.ex: I want it so badly.

defs.d: (manner) In a clear manner.
defs.ex: He enunciated every syllable clearly.

defs.d: (modal) Without a doubt; obviously.
defs.ex: Clearly, the judge erred in his opinion.

defs.d: One's structure or make-up: form, shape, bodily proportions.
An important or main item.
To ascribe the greatest importance to something within a certain context.
To star, to contain.
Literary type using invented or imaginative writing, instead of real facts, usually written as prose.
defs.ex: I am a great reader of fiction.

defs.d: A verbal or written account that is not based on actual events (often intended to mislead).
defs.ex: The butler’s account of the crime was pure fiction.

defs.d: A written or spoken response; part of a conversation.
Something given in reply.
To give a written or spoken response, especially to a question, request, accusation or criticism; to answer.
To act or gesture in response.
defs.ex: Joanne replied to Pete's insult with a slap to his face.

defs.d: Made of wood.
defs.ex: On a recent windy day, hundreds of visitors climbed wooden stairs to take pictures in front of the glacier.

defs.d: As if made of wood; moving awkwardly, or speaking with dull lack of emotion.
defs.ex: wooden acting

defs.d: One who, or that which, consumes.
Someone who trades money for goods or services as an individual.
defs.ex: This new system favours the consumer over the producer.

defs.d: One engaged in politics, especially an elected or appointed government official.
defs.ex: Politicians should serve the country's interest.

defs.d: Specifically, one who regards elected political office as a career.
defs.ex: Unlike the other candidates, I'm not a politician.

defs.d: An element of broadcast programming originating away from the station's or show's control room.
To connect to a computer from a remote location.
At a distance; disconnected.
defs.ex: A remote operator may control the vehicle with a wireless handset.

defs.d: Distant or otherwise inaccessible.
defs.ex: After his fall from the emperor's favor, the general was posted to a remote outpost.

defs.d: In an obvious or clearly apparent manner.
defs.ex: She was in floods of tears and obviously very upset.

defs.d: Used as a filler word, or to introduce information even when not obvious.
defs.ex: You weren't to know, but I've spoken to, obviously, Jim about this, and ...

defs.d: Something which is packed, a parcel, a box, an envelope.
Something which consists of various components, such as a piece of computer software.
defs.ex: Did you test the software package to ensure completeness?

defs.d: To pack or bundle something.
To travel on a package holiday.
A vehicle capable of atmospheric flight due to interaction with the air, such as buoyancy or lift
To affect (someone) strongly and often favourably.
defs.ex: You impressed me with your command of Urdu.

defs.d: To make an impression, to be impressive.
defs.ex: Henderson impressed in his first game as captain.

defs.d: Strongly affected, especially favourably
Stamped, under pressure
A whole number that can be divided by another number with no remainder.
defs.ex: 14, 21 and 70 are multiples of 7

defs.d: Price-earnings ratio.
More than one (followed by plural).
defs.ex: My Swiss Army knife has multiple blades.

defs.d: Having more than one element, part, component, or function, having more than one instance, occurring more than once, usually contrary to expectations (can be followed by a singular).
defs.ex: It was a multiple pregnancy: the woman had triplets.

defs.d: A written work edited and published, as by a certain editor or in a certain manner.
The whole number of copies of a work printed and published at one time.
defs.ex: The first edition was soon sold.

defs.d: In a full manner; without lack or defect.
defs.ex: He fully met his responsibilities.

defs.d: In a full degree; to a full extent.
defs.ex: He is fully capable of meeting his responsibilities.

defs.d: (plural "grand") A thousand of some unit of currency, such as dollars or pounds. (Compare G.)
(plural "grands") A grand piano
Of a large size or extent; great.
defs.ex: a grand army

defs.d: Great in size, and fine or imposing in appearance or impression; illustrious, dignified, magnificent.
defs.ex: His simple vision has transformed into something far more grand.

defs.d: To the full or entire extent.
defs.ex: It is entirely up to you where we go, as I’ll be happy with anywhere.

defs.d: To the exclusion of others.
defs.ex: This part of the park is used entirely by the workers; everyone else will have to go to the other side.

defs.d: The part of an object which is (designed to be) held in the hand when used or moved.
An instrument for effecting a purpose (either literally or figuratively); a tool, or an opportunity or pretext.
